takenRequests.title: Presentation practice
takenRequests.description: Prepare and deliver a short presentation. Ask for one specific piece of feedback.

takenRequests.title: Scholar entry trial
takenRequests.description: Complete a focused scholar commission. Study consistently, improve recall, and apply new information.
checklist: Complete focused practice using the class’s real-world goal
Demonstrate recall, application, or feedback without copying a solution
Review the result and choose a specific next progression

takenRequests.title: Scholar training adventure
takenRequests.description: Build a sustainable month of scholar practice. Complete each milestone before claiming the adventure.

takenRequests.title: Software Development portfolio commission
takenRequests.description: Build and document a working application with tests.
checklist: Define the project and acceptance criteria
Save evidence and review the result

takenRequests.title: Profession practice
takenRequests.description: Spend 20 focused minutes developing your ux designer practice. Record what you learned.

takenRequests.title: Apply a concept
takenRequests.description: Complete three study sessions and apply one concept to a small project.

takenRequests.title: Software Development field assignment
takenRequests.description: Complete three focused practice sessions. Build and document a working application with tests.

takenRequests.title: Scholar commission
takenRequests.description: Study one defined topic for 15 minutes. Close the source, answer five retrieval questions, and check each answer against the source. Correct mistakes and schedule a short review for another day. Record the topic and correct-answer count.

takenRequests.title: Software Development practice
takenRequests.description: Work independently on Software Development using a written case, simulation, or practical exercise. Check the result against a source or marking guide and record one correction.

takenRequests.title: Walk for 5 minutes
takenRequests.description: Walk at a comfortable pace for five minutes.
